semantics.definition: How far the drone runs across, along x and along y, at its Base step (rings included): every part of it is a share of this, and each step of its scale is a share of it. A guess, not agreed: it is the size the drone was made in, 3.68 m (whether to round it to 4 m is open).
semantics.responsibility: Size the drone, and with it every step of its scale.
